title: Previous Transit Easement Agreements
previewText: Whenever, under prior zoning regulations, the owner of a development or enlargement has agreed to provide a transit easement volume on a zoning lot, the existence of such agreement shall be certified by the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission to the Department of Buildings. Such agreement shall be deemed to satisfy the provisions of this Chapter.
